result.instructions: Tools for Propstack, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which properties do we currently have for sale, with their prices?"; "Show my viewings scheduled for next week."; "Which deals are in the negotiation stage of the sales pipeline?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Propstack data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run propstack_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run propstack_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run propstack_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. propstack_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: propstack_list_contacts
tools.title: List or search contacts
tools.description: List or search CRM contacts (Kontakte). Returns business fields only (name, company, email, phone numbers, status, source, tags, owner, dates), never birth data, identity or tax numbers, income or portal tokens. Search by free text (name, email, address, phone), exact email, exact phone number, or filter by status, source, tag, owner and dates. Archived contacts are excluded unless archived is set. GET /contacts.

query.description: Free-text search over first name, last name, emails, address and phone numbers.

email.description: Exact email address of the contact.

phone_number.description: Exact phone number (spaces and dashes are ignored).

status_ids.description: Only contacts with one of these contact-status ids.

source_ids.description: Only contacts from one of these source ids (see propstack_get_reference_data contact_sources).

tag_ids.description: Only contacts with these tag (Merkmal) ids (see propstack_get_reference_data contact_tags).

broker_id.description: Only contacts looked after by this user id (see propstack_list_users).

archived.description: 'only' = only archived contacts, 'include' = archived and active. Default: active only.

include_children.description: Also return sub-contacts (contact persons of a company).

created_after.description: Only contacts created at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

created_before.description: Only contacts created at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

updated_after.description: Only contacts updated at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

updated_before.description: Only contacts updated at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: propstack_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One contact by id with address, salutation, language, notes, GDPR status, owner, status, source, tags, sub-contacts and owned properties. Birth data, identity and tax numbers, income and the portal token are never returned. GET /contacts/{id}.

custom_fields.description: Names of custom fields to return (only these; sensitive ones such as birth date or income are never returned).

include.description: Related records to include: sub-contacts and/or properties the contact owns.

tools.name: propstack_list_properties
tools.title: List or search properties
tools.description: List or search properties (Objekte / units): address, type, marketing type (buy/rent), rooms, areas, prices, status. Images and owners are not returned. Filter by free text, status, tag, project, marketing type, object type, price and area ranges. GET /units.

query.description: Free-text search over unit id, street, zip code, city, district and exposee id.

status_ids.description: Only properties in one of these status ids (see propstack_get_reference_data property_statuses).

tag_ids.description: Only properties with one of these tag ids (see propstack_get_reference_data property_tags).

project_id.description: Only the units of this project id.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. DE.

archived.description: 'only' = only archived properties, 'include' = archived and active. Default: active only.

living_space_from.description: Minimum living space in square metres.

living_space_to.description: Maximum living space in square metres.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: propstack_get_property
tools.title: Get property
tools.description: One property (Objekt) by id: address, type, rooms, areas, prices, status and the description, location and furnishing texts (clipped). No images or owner. GET /units/{id}.

tools.name: propstack_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects (Projekte: a project groups several property units): title, project id, status, address, owner. Not paged; at most 200 are returned. GET /projects.

tools.name: propstack_list_deals
tools.title: List deals
tools.description: List deals (a deal links a contact to a property and sits in a pipeline stage). Filter by pipeline, stage, category (qualified/unqualified/lost), contact, property, project or owner. Use propstack_list_deal_pipelines for stage ids. GET /client_properties.

contact_id.description: Only the deals of this contact.

property_id.description: Only the deals of this property.

project_id.description: Only the deals of this project.

broker_id.description: Only deals owned by this user id.

created_after.description: Only deals created at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

created_before.description: Only deals created at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

include_contact.description: Embed a short contact record in each deal (default false).

include_property.description: Embed a short property record in each deal (default false).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: propstack_list_deal_pipelines
tools.title: List deal pipelines
tools.description: List the deal pipelines with their stages (id, name, position, win chance). Use the stage ids to filter deals or to move a deal. GET /deal_pipelines.

tools.name: propstack_list_activities
tools.title: List activities
tools.description: List the activity timeline (notes, tasks, appointments, e-mails, SMS, letters, rejections, inquiries) with title, linked contacts and properties, state and dates. Message and note bodies are not returned. Filter by type, contact, property, project, owner, category or date. GET /activities.

item_type.description: Kind of activity; 'reminder' is a to-do.

contact_id.description: Only activities linked to this contact.

property_id.description: Only activities linked to this property.

project_id.description: Only activities linked to this project.

broker_id.description: Only activities assigned to this user id.

category_id.description: Only this activity type id (see propstack_get_reference_data activity_types).

starts_after.description: Only activities that start at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

starts_before.description: Only activities that start at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

created_after.description: Only activities created at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

created_before.description: Only activities created at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: propstack_get_task
tools.title: Get task
tools.description: One task by id (a note, to-do or appointment): title, body text (clipped), type, linked contacts, properties and projects (id and name only), due date or start/end. GET /tasks/{id}.

task_id.description: Propstack task id (the id of a note, to-do or appointment).

tools.name: propstack_list_events
tools.title: List calendar events
tools.description: List calendar appointments (Termine, e.g. viewings) in a time window, with title, place, start/end, state and the linked contact, property and project (id and name only). Paged: follow next_page. GET /events.

starts_after.description: Only events that start after this ISO 8601 date-time.

starts_before.description: Only events that start before this ISO 8601 date-time.

broker_id.description: Only events assigned to this user id.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: propstack_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users (staff, Nutzer) of the Propstack account: id, name, work email, position, phone, team. Use the ids as owner/broker filters. GET /brokers.

tools.name: propstack_get_reference_data
tools.title: Get reference data
tools.description: Look up the ids used by other tools: property_statuses, activity_types (note/task/appointment types, needed as note_type_id), contact_sources, reservation_reasons (rejection reasons), contact_tags or property_tags. GET /property_statuses, /activity_types, /contact_sources, /reservation_reasons or /groups.

tools.name: propstack_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a CRM contact. Propstack matches on the email address: if a contact with the same email already exists it is UPDATED with the given fields instead of creating a duplicate. Consent flags (newsletter, contact permission, GDPR status) cannot be set here. Returns the contact id. POST /contacts.

is_company.description: True if the contact is a company.

broker_id.description: User id of the person looking after the contact.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values by field name; only the given fields change.

tools.name: propstack_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: change the given fields of an existing contact; fields not given stay as they are. Returns the updated contact (business fields). PUT /contacts/{id}.

is_company.description: True if the contact is a company.

broker_id.description: User id of the person looking after the contact.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values by field name; only the given fields change.

tools.name: propstack_create_task
tools.title: Create note, to-do or appointment
tools.description: WRITE: create a note, a to-do (with due date) or an appointment (with start and end) in Propstack, linked to contacts, properties or projects. note_type_id is the activity type id (see propstack_get_reference_data activity_types). No e-mail or SMS is sent to the contact; the only mail is the reminder to the assignee when remind_at is set. Returns the new task id. POST /tasks.

kind.description: note = plain note, todo = task with due_date, appointment = event with starts_at and ends_at.

note_type_id.description: Activity type id; must match the kind (see propstack_get_reference_data activity_types).

body.description: Note text (plain text; stored as escaped HTML with line breaks).

contact_ids.description: Contacts the activity is linked to (usually one).

property_ids.description: Properties the activity is linked to.

project_ids.description: Projects the activity is linked to.

broker_id.description: User id the task is assigned to.

remind_at.description: When Propstack e-mails a reminder to the assignee, before due_date (todo only). This sends a mail to a colleague.

tools.name: propstack_update_task
tools.title: Update task
tools.description: WRITE: change the given fields of an existing note, to-do or appointment (for example mark a to-do done, move its due date, or reschedule). Fields not given stay as they are. PUT /tasks/{id}.

body.description: Note text (plain text; stored as escaped HTML with line breaks).

broker_id.description: User id the task is assigned to.

done.description: Mark a to-do done (true) or open (false).

tools.name: propstack_create_deal
tools.title: Create deal
tools.description: WRITE: create a deal linking a contact to a property in a pipeline stage (see propstack_list_deal_pipelines for stage ids). Returns the new deal. POST /client_properties.

broker_id.description: User id of the deal owner.

tools.name: propstack_update_deal
tools.title: Update deal
tools.description: WRITE: change the given fields of a deal, typically move it to another pipeline stage or update its note or price. Fields not given stay as they are. PUT /client_properties/{id}.

deal_stage_id.description: Move the deal to this stage.

note.description: Internal note on the deal (replaces the previous note).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Propstack
prompts.description: What you can do with Propstack here, with example requests to try.
